description: In an ordered ring with positive multiplication preserving and reflecting order, multiplication on the right by a positive factor preserves and reflects non-strict order.
signature:
mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_right.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [Mul α] [Zero α] [Preorder α] {a b c : α} [MulPosMono α]
  [MulPosReflectLE α] (a0 : 0 < a) : b * a ≤ c * a ↔ b ≤ c
